description: LF-normalized UTF-8 byte sizes of the files a default (off, ranked, or manual) run reads on every turn: the coordinators and their prompts, the Scribe hot core, the skill index, model-routing.md, the cost references, and every squad instruction file that auto-loads under .copilot-tracking/squad/. Sizes are the v0.18.1 release content as shipped on main at d46fbea, which matches tag v0.18.1 except squad-roster.instructions.md, changed by the hve-core sync bb7894a that the hotfix branch did not carry. HotFileBudget.Tests.ps1 keeps the set within totalThreshold and each file within perFileThreshold or a documented perFileThresholdOverrides entry. An override redistributes the unchanged aggregate budget; it does not add aggregate headroom. Pull requests ratchet from an over-budget base without permitting further growth. An everyMode entry is an approved allowance for a change that applies in every routing mode (not economy); it is added to that file's per-file threshold and left out of the totalThreshold sum, and it must name its reason.

squad-src/.github/instructions/squad/squ.reason: Upstream cast inventory changes concentrate growth in the roster instruction. This override may consume, but does not enlarge, the 1024-byte aggregate budget.

squad-src/.github/skills/squad/reference.reason: FinOps unit economics (#143) applies in every routing mode by design: the Unit economics paragraph tells the Scribe and the Cost Manager how Measure-SquadLedger counts accepted deliverables, first-pass yield, and rework. It is not an economy-mode change.
